quick_skim.title: Lit3R: Retrieve-Relate-Read for Evidence-Grounded Question Answering over Scientific Literature
quick_skim.abstract: We describe tus-nlp's Lit3R (Retrieve-Relate-Read) system for LitTraceQA, a shared task for literature-grounded question answering that requires systems to retrieve relevant papers, identify supporting evidence, and generate answers. Lit3R combines off-the-shelf retrieval, reranking, and large language model (LLM) components without task-specific training. The retriever iteratively combines BM25-based sparse and dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and LLM-based verification, and complements retrieval based on the question with paper-to-paper expansion. The reader first identifies supporting evidence within individual papers and then synthesizes evidence across papers to produce the final answer and evidence trace. On the official test set, our system ranked 4th on the leaderboard. Our code is available at https://github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对文献落地问答需同时检索相关论文、定位支撑证据并生成答案这一复杂任务，本文提出无需任务特定训练的Lit3R系统。该方法迭代结合BM25稀疏与稠密检索、交叉编码器重排和LLM验证，并用论文间扩展补充基于问题的检索，阅读器先识别单篇文献内的支撑证据再跨文献综合生成答案与证据轨迹。该系统在LitTraceQA共享任务上表现良好，表明检索与验证结合的流水线可有效支持证据落地的问答与核查。

quick_skim.title: EviScope: Paired Counterfactual Evidence Diagnostics for Faithful and Efficient Grounded Language Models
quick_skim.abstract: Grounded language-model systems are often evaluated by final answer accuracy, yet a correct answer can be unsupported, drawn from the wrong source, or produced when evidence is insufficient or contradictory. We introduce EviScope, a paired counterfactual benchmark that holds the question fixed while adding, removing, distracting, or contradicting its evidence. EviScope-v1.1 contains 40 four-condition quartets with repaired counterfactual claims and span-level support labels for automatic evaluation. Across 960 gold-blind generations from Qwen2.5-7B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemini 3.5 Flash, paired metrics expose model-dependent grounding behavior that answer accuracy hides. On two local open models, an explicit evidence-action gate underperforms vanilla RAG on QCS: 0.15 vs. 0.50 for Qwen and 0.10 vs. 0.375 for Llama. Gemini reaches 0.944 joint success under both prompts, yet still answers 5% of conflict cases after contradiction insertion. EviScope therefore distinguishes unsupported answering, conflict blindness, and wrong non-answer actions rather than scoring answers alone.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: EviScope introduces a paired counterfactual benchmark that holds a question fixed while adding, removing, distracting or contradicting evidence, exposing model-dependent grounding failures that final answer accuracy hides, and adds span-level support labels for automatic evaluation.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 现有接地语言模型评估只看最终答案准确率，无法识别答案正确却缺乏支持、来源错误或证据不足的情形。本文提出EviScope，构建配对反事实基准，在固定问题的前提下增删、干扰或矛盾化证据，并给出跨度级支持标签用于自动评估。在多款模型上测试显示，配对指标揭示了准确率所掩盖的接地行为差异。该工作为证据驱动生成与核查系统的忠实性诊断提供了可复用的评估方法。
